exhibition_placements.title: Developable Surface
exhibition_placements.caption: Pevsner builds a curved surface from welded metal filaments. Follow the repeated lines around the form: they define planes and openings without becoming a solid block.
exhibition_placements.curatorial_reason: The subject is the making of a surface from linear elements; exact fit with technique/depth theme.

exhibition_placements.title: How Profound Is the Air
exhibition_placements.caption: The rough outer skin of the alabaster meets a precisely finished interior. Moving around the block reveals where untouched stone becomes carved architecture and where empty space acquires an edge.
exhibition_placements.curatorial_reason: Primary museum explicitly contrastsroughnaturalexterior and highlyfinishedinterior.

exhibition_placements.title: Sun Tunnels: Columba Tunnel (Reconstruction)
exhibition_placements.caption: Holes pierce the concrete in the pattern of the constellation Columba. In the original tunnel, daylight carries that pattern onto the interior. This reconstruction isolates one cylinder from Holt’s four-part installation.

exhibition_placements.title: Bird in Space
exhibition_placements.caption: A long taper suggests flight without wings, feet, or feathers. This later digital interpretation follows Brâncuși’s reduction of a bird to an upward movement held in a fixed form.

exhibition_placements.title: Spiral Jetty
exhibition_placements.caption: Water levels can reveal or submerge this coil of basalt and earth, while salt alters its surface. The model records one appearance of an artwork whose material setting continues to change.

records.source_description:
A 3D rendition of this sculpture which entered the public domain this year, 1st January 2019. More info: https://lifehacker.com/these-1923-copyrighted-works-enter-the-public-domain-in-1825241296

4k (sculpture) + 2k (concrete base) PBR textures.

records.source_description:
School assignment.

"Gate of Hope" is a steel sculpture designed by Alexander Liberman and completed in 1972. It is located on Holmes Hall lawn, in front of the Engineering Building, at University of Hawaii at Manoa. The bright red(cadmium red) color is the primary color accents of Holmes Hall as well as the signature color of Liberman, it is also a frequently used color that represent life and vibrancy to the structure.

It has a connected shape of cylinder which the view throughout this sculpture is changing dramatically in different viewpoint. His several highly recognizable sculptures take inspiration from steel beams, pipes, drums, and such.



Process

Step1: Capture the image of the site using phone.

Step2: Upload images to Autodesk Recap Photo.

Step3: The model will be created. [https://skfb.ly/6HsVI](https://skfb.ly/6HsVI)

Step4: Using the model as a frame, recreate a new model in Blender.

records.source_description: Oeuvre en bronze de Magdalena Abakanowicz (née à Falenty -PO-le 20 mai 1930), érigée sur une esplanade du jardin de la Grande Plage (face à l'hôtel Victoria-Surf) à Biarritz. D'une hauteur de 4.50m et d'un poids de 1.20 tonne cette oeuvre est en forme de main ouverte vers la mer. Elle a été inaugurée le 12 février 2000 en présence de Didier Borotra, maire de Biarritz. -* J'ai vu un jour des mains tendues par des manifestants qui défendaient une cause. records.source_description: COVID19 DATA SCULPTURE United States #ifyouholdthestoneholditinyourhand #datasculptures  #socialdistancing #poetics  a metaphoric #algorithmic #contamination in #humanhands generated using #data from #who #covid19 #globaldata #whocovid19globaldata #datasheet data last updated 2020/05/23 6:39pm WHO Coronavirus Disease (COVID-19) Dashboard full_data.csv The title of the piece is a reference to Caetano Veloso's song 'If you Hold a Stone" (1971 album) dedicated to the Brazilian neoconcrete movement artist Lygia Clark. the work was presented LIVE at 7am PDT on September 12 at Ars Eletronica Garden Los Angeles Telluric Vibrations, UCLA Botanical Gardens – Los Angeles UCLA ArtSci Center (US) \ here the link for all the @artscicenter events http://telluricvibrations.com/ The AR version of the data sculptures are on show at China VISAP 2020 - Arts Program, China Visualization and Visual Analytics Conference.

records.source_description:
Two Forms (Divided Circle)
Sculpture by Barbara Hepworth

Two Forms (Divided Circle) is a bronze sculpture by Barbara Hepworth, designed in 1969. Six numbered copies were cast, plus one retained by the sculptress.
